title: Washi Mosaic
description: Procedurally generated match-3 on handmade washi tiles — new palette, board, and goals every session.
detailedDescription: A match-3 puzzle game wrapped in the aesthetic of traditional Japanese washi paper. Each session generates a unique board with a new color palette drawn from classic Japanese art — indigo, vermilion, bamboo green, gold leaf, and sakura pink. Match three or more adjacent tiles of the same color to clear them and score points. Special tiles appear as you chain combos: firecracker tiles clear a row, fan tiles clear surrounding tiles, and blossom tiles cascade into new matches. The paper texture, subtle fiber patterns, and ink-bleed animations create a tactile, handcrafted feel.
controls: Click a tile, then click an adjacent tile to swap them. Match 3 or more identical tiles in a row to clear them. Chain combos for bonus points.
